entry.title: Cosmic Topology
entry.content: Try very hard for a second and imagine you’re an engineer. You have a differential equation you need to solve, but it’s proving to be very hard to solve. You don’t want to ask your mathmetician friend because everytime you do he berates you by saying maths is superior(I would get along well with this friend) and that the solution is quite elementary really. So you turn to numerical methods.
